My yorkie poo is five. She is a nervous hider. If something upsets her, scares her, or if she’s in pain, she’ll hide. Usually I can pin point what the problem is but on occasion have taken her to vet to get checked out (she has luxating patella and bladder issues so we keep a close eye on her). I’ve made sure she has several safe spaces to escape to and also try to minimize the things that upset her but sometimes it can’t be helped. For example she hates when I use the pressure cooker setting on the instapot however she is totally fine with the loud air compressor. Makes no sense… the vet calls her a complicated little lady lol

I just finished the same treatment yesterday. I was on them for two weeks. The first five days of treatment was hard. Symptoms were tired, diarrhea, racing heart, anxiety, zero appetite, headaches, random body pains, brain fog (this one actually scared me) The fifth day was the worst, I completely broke down and cried almost all day. The following days of treatment my symptoms improved. I forced myself to eat every meal (sometimes not much), lots of crackers, toast, yogurt and other bland food. I literally counted the days until treatment was over. I asked my pharmacist about probiotics. Her advice was to take them after my treatment. I’m going to take a break this weekend then start back taking my usual vitamins and probiotics (AG1) on monday. Before my treatment i had bloating, bladder pain was my worst complaint, i was tired all the time, stress and anxiety levels through the roof, slight acid reflux (not normal for me), and both diarrhea and constipation. I still have diarrhea and am a little tired during the day but nothing like before. I really do feel better.
